note: A valid corner (512 dp, the most a layout may set; the renderer clamps it to half the box, so the circle stays round at any size), and examples with icons this build has: 999 dp and the icon 'home' failed validation

component.doc: An icon in a tinted circle (a list row's leading icon, a category): the circle in tint_bg, the icon in tint, centred. Until issue #325's renderer fix is in the app, an icon-only core://Badge draws 2 dp left of centre; this component leaves that to the renderer rather than padding around it.

params.name: icon
params.doc: An icon name or path:<svg path> (24x24, filled).

params.name: tint
params.doc: The icon's colour (#RRGGBB or a binding such as ${local://theme#accent}).

params.name: tint_bg
params.doc: The circle's colour (#RRGGBB or a binding such as ${local://theme#accent_surface}).

examples.note: a bell in the accent colours
